narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Ink & Paper", editorial edition**

Two colours do all the work: warm paper (#e7e0de) and an espresso near-black ink (#16100d). Ink is the text colour, the primary action colour and the colour of every other band on the home page; there is no accent hue. The 2026-11 editorial redesign took its structure, spacing, type scale and motion from a large-type editorial agency layout. It kept the palette, content and single typeface. Sections alternate paper and ink down the page, headings run very large and light, buttons are square ink rectangles, and nothing carries a shadow at rest.

**There is no white anywhere.** Every surface that the shadcn defaults, the reference layout, or an earlier version of this site painted white now resolves to paper or soft paper. That includes the header, mobile menu, popovers, inputs, cards, the footer, and the blog and `/learn` reading surfaces. This replaces the earlier "white reading surface" decision. Long-form prose now sits directly on paper at a 65ch measure, at 14.5:1 ink-on-paper contrast. The only white left in the repository is on `/sos` (see Do's and Don'ts).
keyCharacteristics: Two colours; ink and paper bands alternate down the home page
One family (Geist): 900 wordmark, 300 headings, uppercase eyebrows
Hairlines for structure; no shadows, gradients or blur
Slow reveal, wordmark rise and a pausable marquee; all off under reduced motion

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Exactly one primary colour, and it is the text colour. No second accent hue.

rules.name: The No White Rule
rules.body: No surface or text is #fff. Paper replaces white; soft paper only where a surface must separate.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: One family (Geist) for everything except code.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from hairlines and paper/ink alternation, never from shadow.

dos: Do use .surface-ink for ink bands instead of hand-inverting colours.
Do open home sections with SectionIntro and inner pages with PageIntro.
Do use the link variant (text + arrow) for secondary actions, default for the primary one.
Do use page-container, section-y, eyebrow and display utilities.
Do keep every claim traceable to existing site copy or the CV.
donts: Don't use white for any surface or text.
Don't add shadows, gradients, glass or blur blobs.
Don't round buttons, cards or panels; no pills.
Don't add a second navigation pattern or list /learn in nav-items.ts.
Don't introduce a second typeface or accent hue.
